goal: The terminal tab is a real terminal on macOS and Windows: a pty behind a full emulator, so interactive programs, prompts, colours and resizing work as they do in PowerShell or Ghostty, with the ownership contract (one shell per tab, a journal, a verified stop) unchanged.
scope: A. node-pty inside the owned worker: a login shell on macOS, PowerShell 7 (or Windows PowerShell) through ConPTY on Windows; the service gains raw write and resize and keeps line input for the ownership contract
B. xterm.js in the tab: keystrokes to the pty, bytes to the emulator, fit on resize, the app's theme, ⌘F find, copy on select, links, the assistant's command mirror, Clear and Restart
C. Ghostty as an engine: ghostty-web (Ghostty's VT core in WebAssembly, xterm-compatible surface) chosen in Settings › General, loaded only when chosen, falling back to xterm.js when it cannot load
D. Windows: the ownership live test with the pty worker on the owner's machine when it is back (~2026-10-05)
acceptance: Interactive programs run in the tab on macOS: a prompt that reads input, less on the alternate screen, colours, a resize the shell sees; the login shell with TERM=xterm-256color (tour)
On Windows PowerShell runs through ConPTY inside the owned Job with the same ownership journal and verified stop (owner's check until the machine is back)
The assistant's commands still mirror into the tab; ownership refusals and the unverified-shutdown path are unchanged (unit tests)
A Ghostty-based engine can be chosen in Settings and passes the same tour, or the reason it cannot is recorded
nextAction: Windows: run app/tests/terminal-ownership.live.mjs and the journey on the owner's machine with the pty worker (ConPTY, pwsh on PATH or Windows PowerShell); then C089's owner items (a working day in the browser; the two desktop bench columns).
truthReview: 2026-10-03: the old tab was a line-at-a-time pipe to a shell (no tty): nothing interactive could run, no colours, no resize. Now main/terminal-worker.js spawns a pty with node-pty 1.1.0 (N-API prebuilds for darwin and win32, arm64 and x64; spawn-helper's execute bit set at runtime) inside the same owned worker, so the journal, the Job on Windows and the verified stop are untouched (tests/terminal-ownership.test.mjs: 10 of 10; tests/terminal-ownership.live.mjs passes on this Mac). The renderer tab is xterm.js 6 with the DOM renderer (the WebGL addon drew at the wrong scale under Electron here and was dropped), fit, search, links, Unicode 11. Ghostty: ghostty-web 0.4.0 works once three things are known — it fetches its WebAssembly from a data: URL (answered from memory, the CSP now allows wasm-unsafe-eval), it reads the custom key handler the opposite way from xterm.js, and it has no search addon (Find is absent on that engine). Both engines pass the nine-check tour. Windows is unrun. Delivered in v0.6.0-nightly.20261003.2 (chain receipt on 19a64bac); electron-builder no longer rebuilds native modules (node-pty's N-API prebuilds ride in app.asar.unpacked), and app/tests/terminal-ownership.live.mjs passes against the packaged Barkdown.app on this Mac.
screenshotReview: Tour screenshots in both evidence folders reviewed: the prompt, the answered read, colours and less on the alternate screen render at the right size on both engines; the ghostty canvas clips its last column slightly. Status shots and the visual run follow the implementation commit.

remaining: Windows proof (owner, when the machine is back)
